com.esignal.jstandard.event

Interface HistoricalBarListener


  • public interface HistoricalBarListener
    The main purpose of this interface is to allow customers to write custom code to process HistoricalBars from HistoricalBarEvent , and FlexData from HistoricalBarFlexEvent.

    The client implemented listener should also listen to requested, error and complete events. The clients should process these methods as fast as possible, otherwise it could impact the latency of delivering data to their application.

    Since:
    01-001-0009
    Author:
    Interactive Data Corporation
    See Also:
    HistoricalBarEvent, HistoricalBarFlexEvent

      • onResponse

        void onResponse(HistoricalBarEvent historicalBarEvent)
        Callback method triggered to signify that a HistoricalBarEvent is available for processing. The event object contains list of HistoricalBar objects. These can be accessed via HistoricalBarEvent.getHistoricalBarList().
        Parameters:
        historicalBarEvent - A HistoricalBarEvent object which wraps information about HistoricalBar.
        See Also:
        HistoricalBarEvent, HistoricalBar

      • onFlexResponse

        void onFlexResponse(HistoricalBarFlexEvent historicalBarFlexEvent)
        Callback method triggered to signify that a HistoricalBarFlexEvent is available for processing. The event object contains a JSON schema, the payload (of Flex data) and an iterator to traverse over the records and fields in the payload. This can be accessed via getSchema, getByteBuffer, and the iterator method of the event. See HistoricalBarFlexEvent and FlexData for more details.
        Parameters:
        historicalBarFlexEvent - A HistoricalBarFlexEvent object which wraps information about the Flex History response.
        Since:
        01-024-0000
        See Also:
        HistoricalBarFlexEvent, FlexData, FlexDataField
